questions.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,$ ${x}_{2}=-4,$ and ${x}_{3}=-3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-1.$ Find $P(x).$
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,$ ${x}_{1}=-4,$ and ${x}_{3}=-3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-1,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-1(x-(-5))(x-(-4))(x-(-3)) \\  & =-(x+5)(x+4)(x+3)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-(x+5)(x+4)(x+3) & =-({x}^{2}+9x+20)(x+3) \\  & =-({x}^{3}+3{x}^{2}+9{x}^{2}+27x+20x+60) \\  & =-{x}^{3}-12{x}^{2}-47x-60.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-{x}^{3}-12{x}^{2}-47x-60.$

questions.problem: The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 3\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $3.$ Find $f(x).$
questions.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 3\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=3,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =3(x-(-5))(x-3\text{i})(x-(-3\text{i})) \\  & =3(x+5)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}3(x+5)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i}) & = \\ 3(x+5)({x}^{2}-(3\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 3(x+5)({x}^{2}+9) & = \\ 3({x}^{3}+9x+5{x}^{2}+45) & = \\ 3{x}^{3}+15{x}^{2}+27x+135 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=3{x}^{3}+15{x}^{2}+27x+135.$

questions.problem:
The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=3,{x}_{3}=4,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $2.$ Find $P(x).$

$P(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,-$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$
{{field-3}}$x\,-$
{{field-4}}
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=3,$ ${x}_{2}=3,$ and ${x}_{3}=4,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=2,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =2(x-3)(x-3)(x-4)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x-3)(x-3)(x-4) & =2({x}^{2}-6x+9)(x-4) \\  & =2({x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-6{x}^{2}+24x+9x-36) \\  & =2({x}^{3}-10{x}^{2}+33x-36) \\  & =2{x}^{3}-20{x}^{2}+66x-72.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=2{x}^{3}-20{x}^{2}+66x-72.$

questions.problem:
The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=5,{x}_{2}={x}_{3}=-2,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-4.$ Find $P(x).$

$P(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,+$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$
{{field-3}}$x\,+$
{{field-4}}
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}={x}_{3}=-2,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-4(x-5)(x-(-2))(x-(-2)) \\  & =-4(x-5)(x+2)(x+2)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-4(x-5)(x+2)(x+2) & =-4(x-5)({x}^{2}+4x+4) \\  & =-4({x}^{3}+4{x}^{2}+4x-5{x}^{2}-20x-20) \\  & =-4({x}^{3}-{x}^{2}-16x-20) \\  & =-4{x}^{3}+4{x}^{2}+64x+80.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-4{x}^{3}+4{x}^{2}+64x+80.$

questions.problem:

The Argand diagram above shows the roots of the cubic polynomial $f(x).$ Find $f(x)$ given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $-2.$

$f(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,-$
{{field-2}}$x\,+$
{{field-3}}
questions.worked_solution:
From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2,3}=-1\pm 3\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-2.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}-x(-1-3\text{i})-x(-1+3\text{i})+(-1+3\text{i})(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}+2x+10) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+10x-2{x}^{2}-4x-20) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+6x-20) & = \\ -2{x}^{3}-12x+40 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=-2{x}^{3}-12x+40.$
